result: No scratch files remain. Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java` with 25 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering plain/custom-format patterns, locale handling, choice formats, quoted text, `equals`/`hashCode`, the disabled mutator methods, and error cases (null pattern, unmatched braces, unterminated quotes/format elements, invalid argument index, unknown format type). All tests compile under `--release 8` and pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
